entries.name: approval
entries.description: The approval policy: `ask` sends writes, edits and commands to the approval flow; `auto-edit` runs file writes and edits and still asks for commands. `LUNATE_APPROVAL` overrides it.

entries.name: bashGuard
entries.description: Guards bash commands against edits outside the trusted working directory. There is no environment-variable override.

entries.name: decisions.approvals
entries.description: The approval-gate consumer; a deny recommendation reaching `approvalsThreshold` escalates the ask when `enforce`. Decision consumers are enabled by the user only.

entries.name: decisions.approvalsThreshold
entries.description: A finite probability from 0 through 1: what a deny recommendation must reach to escalate the approval ask.

entries.name: decisions.profile
entries.description: The decision profile the layer runs on; without it the layer is unavailable and nothing is offered, never erroring.

entries.name: decisions.questions
entries.description: Adds a probability marker beside the top option of a question; always display-only, the user still chooses.

entries.name: decisions.routing
entries.description: The model-routing consumer; picks the most probable profile without consulting any threshold.

entries.name: decisions.routingProfiles
entries.description: Two to 255 unique configured profile names the router may select among; routing requires at least two.

entries.name: decisions.tool
entries.description: Offers the `decide` tool, only when `decisions.profile` resolves as well.

entries.name: favorites
entries.description: The ordered favourite model ids, at most eight unique entries; schema 2 and later.

entries.name: model
entries.description: The default model id. `LUNATE_MODEL` overrides it.

entries.name: output.spillThresholdTokens
entries.description: The estimated-token threshold (UTF-8 bytes / 4) above which a tool result is spilled. A project file may lower it, never raise it. `LUNATE_TOOL_SPILL_THRESHOLD` overrides it.

entries.name: output.toolResultLimit
entries.description: Characters of one tool result before truncation. A project file may lower it, never raise it. `LUNATE_TOOL_OUTPUT_LIMIT` overrides it.

entries.name: profiles.*.capabilities.apis
entries.description: API identifiers the profile declares itself able to speak; open strings, unknown facts stay allowed. User scope only.

entries.name: profiles.*.capabilities.features
entries.description: Feature names the profile declares supported; open strings, unknown facts stay allowed. User scope only.

entries.name: profiles.*.capabilities.inputModalities
entries.description: Input modalities the profile declares supported, for example `text` or `image`; open strings. User scope only.

entries.name: profiles.*.capabilities.outputModalities
entries.description: Output modalities the profile declares supported; open strings. User scope only.

entries.name: profiles.*.contextWindow
entries.description: The profile's context window in tokens; a project profile may lower it against the user value, never raise it.

entries.name: profiles.*.maxOutput
entries.description: The profile's maximum output tokens; a project profile may lower it against the user value, never raise it.

entries.name: profiles.*.model
entries.description: The catalog model id the profile selects; required.

entries.name: profiles.*.provider
entries.description: The provider entry the profile selects; a project profile may only reference a user provider, never define one.

entries.name: profiles.*.reasoningBudget
entries.description: The profile's reasoning budget in tokens.

entries.name: profiles.*.reasoningLevel
entries.description: The profile's reasoning level.

entries.name: profiles.*.temperature
entries.description: The profile's sampling temperature; a finite number.

entries.name: projection.batchTurns
entries.description: Model turns between request-time projection rewrites. `LUNATE_PROJECTION_BATCH_TURNS` overrides it.

entries.name: projection.maskErrorTurns
entries.description: The mask window for error tool results, in model turns; must be at least the success window. `LUNATE_PROJECTION_MASK_ERROR_TURNS` overrides it.

entries.name: projection.maskTurns
entries.description: The mask window for successful tool results, in model turns. `LUNATE_PROJECTION_MASK_TURNS` overrides it.

entries.name: providers.*.baseUrl
entries.description: The endpoint's base URL: absolute and https, or http only for a loopback host. Definitions live in user settings only.

entries.name: providers.*.catalogName
entries.description: The display name the model picker shows for the endpoint.

entries.name: providers.*.model
entries.description: The model id requests use through the endpoint unless a selection overrides it.

entries.name: roslyn.maxLoadedWorkspaces
entries.description: C# workspaces kept loaded across roots; a further root's load evicts the least-recently-used one. Never `unlimited`.

entries.name: schemaVersion
entries.description: Required; 1 or 2 are readable, 2 is written.

entries.name: startupHeader
entries.description: Prints the welcome header when a session starts. `LUNATE_STARTUP_HEADER` overrides it.

entries.name: subagents.concurrency
entries.description: Concurrent child runs in one tree, or `unlimited`. A project file may lower it, never raise it. `LUNATE_SUBAGENTS_CONCURRENCY` overrides it.

entries.name: subagents.tokenBudget
entries.description: Tokens per child run, or `unlimited`. A project file may lower it, never raise it. `LUNATE_SUBAGENTS_TOKEN_BUDGET` overrides it.

entries.name: subagents.treeTokenBudget
entries.description: Tokens per top-level run tree, or `unlimited`. A project file may lower it, never raise it. `LUNATE_SUBAGENTS_TREE_TOKEN_BUDGET` overrides it.

entries.name: thinking
entries.description: The session thinking level; `/thinking` changes it per session.

entries.name: thinkingFull
entries.description: Commits the full reasoning text instead of the collapsed thought line.

entries.name: toolDetails
entries.description: How much of a tool call the scrollback commits: the header line only, or the header with the bounded output excerpt and diff panel. `LUNATE_TOOL_DETAILS` overrides it.

entries.name: tools.extra
entries.description: Optional search tools to register beside the core set; empty means none. `LUNATE_EXTRA_TOOLS` overrides it.

entries.name: tui.fullscreen
entries.description: Starts the interactive session in the full-screen workspace.

entries.name: tui.keys.*
entries.description: A binding id (see the guide's key table) remapped to its declared keys, persisted so it survives a restart.

entries.name: tui.theme
entries.description: The colour-depth policy applied to the transcript and status line; a theme can only lower the depth, so `NO_COLOR` still wins.

entries.name: updateCheck
entries.description: Checks GitHub Releases at most once a day and links a newer release's changelog. `LUNATE_UPDATE_CHECK` overrides it.

entries.name: usages.chat
entries.description: The chat profile; the usage every other usage falls back to when unassigned.

entries.name: usages.compaction
entries.description: The profile used to compact a session; used only when assigned.

entries.name: usages.fast
entries.description: The profile used where a fast model is wanted.

entries.name: usages.subagents
entries.description: The profile child runs use.

entries.name: verify
entries.description: How staged writes behave when a write verifier refuses the content: refuse, write and report unverified, or skip verifier selection. File-only; no environment override.
